metadata.description: Personal Claude Code skill library — specialized workflows for Python development, debugging, code review, planning, and more. python-dev, python-code-review, and guided-implementation expect the minimality ladder (shared/minimality-ladder.md) in your CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: codebase-research
plugins.description: Navigate and map codebases with ranked, annotated answers instead of raw search output.

plugins.name: explain-code
plugins.description: Explain how and why code works, with an analogy, a diagram, and a walkthrough.

plugins.name: goal-workflow
plugins.description: Implement a spec fully, check each requirement off, and end with a requirement-by-requirement report.

plugins.name: guided-implementation
plugins.description: Guide you through writing the code yourself, one piece per turn.

plugins.name: hac-init
plugins.description: Bootstrap a .hac/ (Human-Agent Context) directory for multi-session work.

plugins.name: help
plugins.description: Cheat sheet of the personal skills in this library.

plugins.name: interview-me
plugins.description: One-question-at-a-time intent extraction for underspecified asks.

plugins.name: notion-cli
plugins.description: Notion pages and databases via the ntn CLI or the Notion MCP, whichever is cheaper for the job.

plugins.name: planning-and-task-decomposition
plugins.description: Turn clear requirements into an ordered, verifiable implementation plan.

plugins.name: playwright-cli
plugins.description: Automate browser interactions, test web pages, and work with Playwright tests.

plugins.name: pr-description
plugins.description: Generate a minimal, clear PR description from the branch diff and the repo's PR template.

plugins.name: python-code-review
plugins.description: Review Python changes for correctness, security, simplicity, and conventions, with a verdict.

plugins.name: python-dev
plugins.description: Planning-first Python development with Python 3.13+, ruff, pyright, and pytest.

plugins.name: python-project-scaffold
plugins.description: Scaffold a new Python project with production-ready tooling and structure.

plugins.name: systematic-debugging
plugins.description: Four-phase debugging method that finds the root cause before any fix.

plugins.name: task-handover
plugins.description: Write a HANDOVER.md so the next agent or engineer can resume with no prior context.

plugins.name: task-scope-and-spec
plugins.description: Scope a loose engineering task into a tight, testable spec list.

plugins.name: write-tests
plugins.description: Write focused pytest tests for critical paths, edge cases, and error handling.
